sourcePrd: MOB-External Menu Redirection in Alumni Portal

environment.buildBehavior: App cold-start opens Alumni user landing page directly (no OTP/login)

testcases.TestCaseName: Alumni landing page displays external menu tile configured for Only Alumni Portal
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Alumni debug build launches to landing page; external menu redirection tile appears in apps list with correct label and icon (Allowed In = Only Alumni Portal).
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; admin configured Only Alumni Portal redirection; Appium session starts app and lands on Alumni landing page automatically
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: External menu redirection tile appears in the Alumni Portal apps list with the correct label and icon

testcases.TestCaseName: Tapping external menu tile opens configured external URL on Android
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Alumni debug build on landing page: tap external menu tile and verify redirection opens the admin-configured HTTPS menu URL.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; admin configured Only Alumni Portal redirection with valid menu URL; app lands on Alumni landing page on launch
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tapping the tile redirects to the configured external menu URL (WebView or external browser)

testcases.TestCaseName: Tapping external menu tile triggers Android deeplink when deeplink is configured
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Alumni debug build on landing page: tap tile with Android deeplink configured and verify target package opens; fallback menu URL when target app is unavailable.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; web admin creates YouTube extra menu with Android deeplink; mobile syncs and verifies tile tap opens YouTube or fallback URL.
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Android deeplink opens target package; if app missing, fallback HTTPS menu URL opens in browser

testcases.TestCaseName: External menu tile is not shown on employee mobile landing page
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Employee mobile app login: alumni-only external menu redirection (Allowed In = Only Alumni Portal) must not appear on the employee dashboard apps list.
testcases.Precondition: Admin configured Only Alumni Portal redirection; valid employee mobile credentials; standard employee app build (not Alumni debug). Set RunMode=Yes when employee production/debug build is installed (not alumni cold-start build).
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Redirection entries targeting Only Alumni Portal do not appear on employee mobile experience

testcases.TestCaseName: Default Alumni Portal apps list items remain visible alongside external tiles
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin disables alumni portal modules, mobile verifies only Profile/HR Policies/HR Documents remain; web re-enables modules and mobile verifies full default apps plus Darwinbox external tile.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; Chrome available for web admin; alumni portal settings and Darwinbox external redirection configured
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Disabling alumni portal settings leaves baseline default apps only; re-enabling restores full default apps and external tile remains additive

testcases.TestCaseName: Multiple Only Alumni Portal redirections all render on landing page
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin creates google extra menu (Only Alumni Portal); mobile verifies Darwinbox and google tiles on Alumni landing page; web deletes google menu to revert.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; Darwinbox redirection pre-configured; admin can access extra menu settings; Chrome available for web automation
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: All alumni-targeted external redirection entries (Darwinbox + google) are visible on the landing page; web settings reverted after test

testcases.TestCaseName: Returning alumni user sees persisted external tiles after cold launch
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: External menu tiles load on cold launch for returning alumni

testcases.TestCaseName: External menu tile not shown when no Only Alumni Portal redirection exists
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin sets Darwinbox extra menu alumni_portal=0 via editnewmenu; mobile pull-to-refresh verifies tile hidden; web restores alumni_portal=1 and mobile verifies tile returns.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; Darwinbox extra menu exists on mobile4 with resource id a6a566d0d59521650254959
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Darwinbox tile hidden when alumni_portal=0; restored when alumni_portal=1 after pull-to-refresh

testcases.TestCaseName: Admin Allowed In dropdown shows Only Alumni Portal when Alumni SKU enabled
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Only Alumni Portal option visible in Allowed In dropdown

testcases.TestCaseName: Employee-targeted redirection tile not duplicated on Alumni Portal
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Alumni tile visible; employee-only tile absent on alumni landing

testcases.TestCaseName: Invalid or unreachable external URL shows error state on tap
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Web admin edits Darwinbox extra menu URL to https://darwinbox.c; mobile pull-to-refresh verifies tile opens incorrect URL; web restores https://darwinbox.com.
testcases.Precondition: Alumni debug build installed; Darwinbox extra menu exists on mobile4 with resource id a6a566d0d59521650254959
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tile tap opens incorrect URL after web edit; URL restored to https://darwinbox.com/ in teardown

testcases.TestCaseName: Network unavailable when tapping external menu tile
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Network error shown; app remains stable after re-enable

testcases.TestCaseName: Tap external menu tile when session expired redirects to login
testcases.Precondition: Requires session expiry hook or timed background
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Login screen instead of external URL

testcases.TestCaseName: Android deeplink target app not installed falls back per policy
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Fallback URL opens when target app missing

testcases.TestCaseName: Rapid double-tap on external menu tile does not open duplicate sessions
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Single redirection context after double tap

testcases.TestCaseName: External tile hidden after admin deletes redirection entry
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tile visible after create, removed after EditNewMenu delete and pull-to-refresh

testcases.TestCaseName: Malformed deeplink string does not crash Alumni app
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: App process remains active after malformed deeplink tap

testcases.TestCaseName: Very long menu label renders without breaking apps list layout
testcases.extraMenuName: Long Alumni External Menu Label For Automation Test
testcases.expectedMenuLabel: Long Alumni External Menu Label For Automation Test
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Long label visible; apps list remains usable

testcases.TestCaseName: Maximum number of external redirection tiles on single landing page
testcases.Precondition: Requires N menus at product upper limit pre-configured
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: All configured tiles up to limit render and remain tappable

testcases.TestCaseName: Special characters in menu label display correctly
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Special characters render correctly on tile label

testcases.TestCaseName: HTTPS menu URL with query parameters redirects correctly
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Query string preserved in destination URL

testcases.TestCaseName: Empty apps list state when zero apps and zero redirections
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Empty state handled gracefully

testcases.TestCaseName: Config update while app in background refreshes tiles on resume
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: New tile appears after background + web create

testcases.TestCaseName: Only Alumni Portal option hidden when Alumni SKU disabled
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Only Alumni Portal not listed in Allowed In dropdown

testcases.TestCaseName: Tile icon missing or broken URL shows placeholder icon
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Fallback document+link placeholder icon shown when tile icon missing; tile remains tappable

testcases.TestCaseName: App backgrounding during external redirection resume
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: App recovers after background during redirect

testcases.TestCaseName: Network switch WiFi to mobile data during redirection
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Graceful handling without crash

testcases.TestCaseName: Device rotation on Alumni landing page preserves external tiles
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tile visible in portrait and landscape

testcases.TestCaseName: Incoming system notification overlay during tile tap
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Redirection initiates or safe retry available

testcases.TestCaseName: Low-memory app kill and relaunch restores landing page tiles
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: External tiles reload after force-stop relaunch

testcases.TestCaseName: Airplane mode on landing page prevents tap redirect and shows error
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Offline blocks redirect; online retry succeeds

testcases.TestCaseName: Press device back from external browser returns to Alumni Portal
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Back navigation returns to Alumni landing page

testcases.TestCaseName: Split-screen multitasking while Alumni landing page visible
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Tile visible and tappable in split-screen

testcases.TestCaseName: Lock screen during redirection after device wake
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Lock/unlock during redirect does not corrupt app
